output.tldr: Infosys is a cash-rich, debt-free giant navigating a growth slowdown. Management is consistently lowering revenue guidance while maintaining margins through efficiency, though AI revenue remains a small, lumpy contributor.

promises.promise: FY27 revenue growth guidance of 1.5% to 3.5% in constant currency terms.
promises.actual: Reported numbers show Q1 FY27 growth at 14.0% and Q2 FY27 at 10.7% YoY.
promises.why: Management cut guidance to 1.5%-3% in Q1 and further to 1%-2% in Q2.

promises.promise: Maintain operating margin guidance at 20% to 22% for FY27.
promises.actual: Reported numbers show operating margins held steady at 24.0% for Q1 and Q2 FY27.
promises.why: Actual margins have consistently exceeded the top end of the guided range.

promises.promise: Recruit approximately 20,000 college graduates for the full year.
promises.actual: Management claimed to have recruited 20,000 college graduates through March.
promises.why: The hiring target for the year was met as stated in the Q3 call.

promises.promise: Build a team of 6,000 Frontier Engineers over the next few years.
promises.actual: No specific update provided on the current count of Frontier Engineers.
promises.why: The multi-year horizon has not yet elapsed.

promises.promise: Strong growth in Financial Services and Energy/Utilities for the next year.
promises.actual: Financial Services currently represents 27.9% of revenue per the annual report.
promises.why: The target period refers to the next financial year.

credibility.line: Management is reliable on margins but has repeatedly walked back revenue guidance within the same fiscal year, suggesting poor demand visibility.

narrative_vs_numbers.says: AI revenue is growing robustly and reached 10.5% of total revenue.
narrative_vs_numbers.shows: Reported numbers show total revenue growth slowed from 14% to 10.7% YoY.

narrative_vs_numbers.says: Operating margins are stable despite investments in AI and talent.
narrative_vs_numbers.shows: Reported numbers show a flat 24% margin for five consecutive quarters.

narrative_vs_numbers.says: Large deal TCV is healthy, reaching $5.2 billion in Q2 FY27.
narrative_vs_numbers.shows: Reported numbers show Q2 revenue grew only 1.2% sequentially.

bull.point: Exceptional cash flow generation and quality.
bull.evidence: Operating cash is 1.10x reported profit over 5 years.

bull.point: Resilient operating margins despite macro headwinds.
bull.evidence: Maintained 24% margin for five straight quarters.

bull.point: Strong balance sheet provides significant optionality.

bear.point: Consistent downward revisions to revenue growth guidance.
Significant contingent liabilities and legal risks.
bear.evidence: ₹3,117 crore in unacknowledged income tax claims.

bear.point: AI revenue contribution remains small and potentially lumpy.
bear.evidence: AI services were only 5.5% of revenue in Q3.

watch_next: Stabilization of revenue guidance in the Q3 FY27 update.
Impact of US DOJ investigation on H-1B visa classifications.
Conversion of the $5.2 billion large deal TCV into revenue.
